model.description: Model name of the supported mobile phone.

connection.description: Type of connection to the phone. Options: serial, bluetooth, infrared, nokia5110, nokia6210, nokia7110.

port.description: Device path for the phone connection (e.g., serial port, Bluetooth device).

bluetooth_address.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the phone (required when connection=bluetooth).

baud_rate.description: Baud rate for serial connection. Common values: 9600, 19200, 38400, 115200.

smsc.description: SMS Service Center (SMSC) phone number in E.164 format without leading + (e.g., 1234567890).

sim_pin.description: PIN code to unlock the SIM card. Leave empty if not needed or already unlocked.

connect_retry.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed connection to the phone.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to use syslog instead.

service_user.description: Unix user to run the daemon as for security (recommended to avoid root).

service_group.description: Unix group to run the daemon as.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file used by the daemon.

check_interval.description: Seconds between checks for new SMS messages in the spool directories.

max_send.description: Maximum number of SMS messages to send in one batch.

outgoing_dir.description: Directory where outgoing SMS files are placed for sending.

incoming_dir.description: Directory where received SMS messages are stored.

sent_dir.description: Directory where successfully sent SMS messages are archived.

delivery_reports.description: Enable or disable SMS delivery reports (values: 'yes', 'no').

db_type.description: Database backend for SMS metadata and history. Options: null (file only), mysql, postgresql, sqlite.

mysql_host.description: MySQL server hostname or IP (used if db_type=mysql).

mysql_user.description: MySQL user with access to the SMS database.

mysql_database.description: Name of the MySQL database to use for SMS data.

pg_host.description: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP (used if db_type=postgresql).

pg_user.description: PostgreSQL user with access to the SMS database.

pg_database.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to use for SMS data.

sqlite_file.description: Path to the SQLite database file (used if db_type=sqlite).

trusted_senders.description: List of phone numbers (E.164 format) allowed to access the SMS gateway (e.g., for admin commands).

items.description: Allowed sender phone number in E.164 format without leading + (e.g., 15551234567)
